high_level_description: A professional game character turnaround sheet showing an original female explorer designed for an action-adventure game, presented with multiple clean reference views for 3D modeling.

style_description.aesthetics: professional character sheet, clean production presentation, readable reference layout, structured visual clarity
style_description.lighting: flat neutral studio lighting with minimal shadows to preserve form readability across all views
style_description.art_style: AAA game character concept sheet with clean anatomy, consistent proportions, practical costume design, and clear modeling-reference presentation

compositional_deconstruction.background: A light neutral concept sheet background with subtle layout spacing and minimal graphic noise.

elements.desc: A full-body front view of the same original explorer character, placed as one clean reference view, standing upright in a neutral pose with clear visibility of outfit layers and accessories.
A full-body side view of the same character, aligned as a modeling turnaround reference, showing profile silhouette and gear placement.
A full-body back view of the same character, showing backpack straps, belt placement, boots, and rear garment structure.
A three-quarter hero view of the same character, slightly more dynamic, used as the visual highlight of the sheet while keeping the same outfit and proportions.
